candidate.title: scRC-Seq
candidate.scope: The single-cell retrotransposon capture sequencing schematic assigned to the scRC-Seq card: one route from a biological suspension through FACS, individual nucleus picking, whole-genome amplification, Illumina library construction and sequence capture to an enriched DNA library. The Upton et al. L1-Ta LNA-probe implementation resolves the materials and capture interface. Single-cell RC-seq is the expanded/alternate styling of the same target; MALBAC is its amplification component, not an alternative target assay. The left novel-insertion and genomic-DNA cartoons are explanatory insets without a material-transfer arrow. No separate sequencing, WGS-quality-control, pooling or validation branch is drawn, so those reported activities are context, not additional graph operations.

operations.label: Sequence capture
operations.description: Select target-containing DNA fragments from the sequencing library by hybridization within retrotransposon termini. Adjacent genomic sequence is co-retained on the same fragment, yielding an enriched junction library. The gray support beneath the magenta site depicts the capture interface.
operations.mechanism: The primary implementation uses LNA probes targeting the extreme 5′ and 3′ ends of L1-Ta; their 5′ biotin supports capture on streptavidin beads. Probe/support chemistry resolves the unlabeled capture icon; it is a component of this operation.
operations.information_effect: Enriches DNA that links an L1 terminus to adjacent genomic sequence. Subsequent paired-end sequencing (reported, not drawn as a downstream operation) can identify L1-genome junctions and candidate non-reference integration sites associated with the source nucleus. Capture alone does not establish somatic status or exclude molecular artifacts.
